decisionChecklist.question: Which surfaces require sign-in, and what happens to a signed-out user who reaches one?
What happens when leaving a surface with unsaved input?
How is in-progress work shown (spinner, skeleton, disabled controls)?
Where and how are errors shown (inline, toast, error page)?
How is success confirmed for non-navigating actions?
Which surfaces are directly linkable/bookmarkable, and what does a bad link show?
Which viewports are supported, and does layout or navigation change on mobile?
Target accessibility level; keyboard and focus behavior for modals.
